description: Drainage modification associated with the northern Lapstone Structural Complex, New South Wales, Australia is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. The Lapstone Structural Complex (LSC) comprises a series of north-trending faults and monoclinal flexures forming the eastern margin of the Blue Mountains Plateau, ~50 km west of the Sydney CBD. The LSC is considered a potential source of large earthquakes, however its evolution, and in particular its tectonic history is not well constrained. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are AU-NSW, Earth Sciences, GA Publication, Published_External, Record. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, PDF. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
